title: Google Maps Business Scraper
description: Finds local businesses on Google Maps for a search term and area, returning name, rating, review count, category, address and — optionally — phone number and website. Useful for local lead lists and market research. Drives a real browser, so it is slower than the API-based Actors and should be used at modest volume; heavy use from one IP will get throttled.

query.description: What to search for, including the area. Example: "dentists in Austin, TX" or "coffee shops near Shoreditch London".

maxResults.description: How many businesses to return. Each one costs scrolling time; keep it modest.

includeDetails.description: Open each listing to also collect phone number and website. Much slower — roughly two seconds per business — but this is where the contact details are.

language.description: Interface language code, e.g. 'en'. Affects how labels are worded.
